claim_one_line: GENESIS v1.49 (an amendment arc; P-208, after S150's full suite): GM1, two records, moves from POSTULATED to DERIVED given one input -- the records have a non-trivial common character in SL(2, C) (B1677 sealed; B1679, the SM seat's W109 proof for every n, verified): for every n >= 3 only the trivial character is fixed by every move, at n = 2 the record's moves fix the trivial and quaternion points, the finite image then forced and the triplet following (T2); the rank-two target priced. The principle's form stated as the family of wordings, a -> ab, b -> a its smallest instance under C2b (P-206; B1676: the golden rule's tick a class property). The price is not re-counted: one postulate exchanged for one input. 0 of 19.
